details:
Flame in Freefall: AI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data is a prototype designed to explore fire behavior and fire-safety challenges in microgravity environments.

The prototype presents selected combustion parameters and visualizes illustrative results to help users understand how combustion may behave in space. It uses simulated values for demonstration purposes, including selected oxygen and fuel parameters.

The project aims to make space-combustion concepts more accessible through data visualization and an interactive demonstration. In the future, it could be enhanced with verified NASA datasets, scientifically validated analysis, and AI-based insights.

The current prototype is intended for educational and exploratory use. Its simulated results are not actual NASA measurements, and its predictions have not been scientifically validated.
